request.deadline: 12-month delivery period from August 2026 to July 2027
deliverables: Frontend maintenance and cross-platform development for web, browser extension, iOS, Android, and beta channels
Backend infrastructure and operations including multi-region servers, Cardano nodes, DBSync, application services, metadata aggregation, monitoring, and incident response
User support through Discord ticketing, Telegram, public channels, project support, wiki maintenance, and educational videos
Governance tooling enhancements including DRep dashboards, proposal browsers, in-wallet voting, and proposal creation
Eternl Core rewrite, Eternl Hub, enhanced hardware wallet support, enhanced wallet data export, and ongoing operations
Periodic independent audits of treasury fund use and oversight metrics
request.what: 12 months of operations, maintenance, and improvements for the Eternl non-custodial Cardano light wallet, including frontend and backend development, infrastructure, support, administration, and fund-use audits.

claims.claim: Eternl says it is a non-custodial Cardano light wallet available on web, browser extension, Android, and iOS.
The proposal requests ₳2,350,000 at about $0.1787 per Ada to cover an annual operating cost of about $420,000.
The budget allocates 55% to frontend, 25% to backend, 5% to support, 13% to admin, and 2% to audits.
Eternl says 10 people contribute to the project and this proposal funds 6.0 FTE at $70,000 per FTE.
Eternl plans to introduce paid Pro plans at $96 per year for personal users and $360 per year for companies, and says about 5,500 Pro users would fully cover the $420,000 annual cost.
Eternl says it has about 100,000 browser-extension installs and about 30,000 installs across Android and iOS.
The proposer commits to converting up to $420,000 worth of Ada into stablecoins, depositing it in a public company wallet, and returning any Ada above that amount to the treasury.
The proposer says independent audits of treasury fund use will be performed in February 2027 and August 2027 by a party unaffiliated with Tastenkunst GmbH or the Eternl team.
Eternl says every paid Pro plan will be recorded on-chain with metadata and that it will publish Pro plan earnings reports plus repayment and donation transaction hashes.
Eternl says 10-18% of Cardano mainnet transactions are conducted via Eternl and that it has provided access across several platforms with basically zero downtime for over five years.

summary: The document presents a large treasury request for one year of Eternl operations with a detailed top-level budget, sustainability and repayment plan, and governance-audit commitments, but several major adoption, impact, feasibility, and risk claims are asserted without embedded verification.
